app.name: Mizan
app.tagline: One number for what you're worth, and a plan that keeps it growing.

auth.verifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{contact}}.
auth.resetRequested: If that account exists, a code is on its way.
auth.offlineNeedsSession: Sign in once while online; after that Mizan works offline.

lock.title: Locked
lock.setBody: Mizan locks when you leave it. A PIN keeps your numbers off the task switcher.
lock.enrollBiometric: Also allow biometrics on this device

home.noAccounts: No cash accounts yet. Add your wallet, bank and cash at home to start.
home.comingSoon: Bills, transactions, debts, goals and gold arrive in the next milestones.

sync.title: Sync

status.offline: Offline. Changes will sync when you're back.

sync.conflictsBody: These edits lost to a newer change from another device. Nothing was lost silently.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showUsd: Also show net worth in US dollars
settings.notificationsBody: Reminders arrive once a day through this device's push service, worded in your language. Each kind can be switched off; quiet mode silences all of them.

notificationClasses.payDay: Pay-day prompt to plan the month

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email, phone or password is incorrect
errors.IDENTIFIER_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with this email or phone already exists
errors.INVALID_IDENTIFIER: Enter a valid email address or phone number
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.INVALID_VERIFICATION_CODE: The code is wrong or has expired
errors.VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one.
errors.VERIFICATION_RESEND_TOO_SOON: Please wait before requesting another code
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.INVITATION_NOT_FOUND: This invitation link is not valid.
errors.INVITATION_EXPIRED: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new link.
errors.ALREADY_A_MEMBER: You are already a member of this household.
errors.ONLY_HOUSEHOLD: This is your only household; you cannot leave it.
errors.HOUSEHOLD_DELETION_PENDING: This household is scheduled for deletion.
errors.PUSH_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server has no push keys configured.

income.title: Income
income.nothingPlanned: Nothing planned this month. Add an income source or an irregular receipt.
income.name: Name
income.fxRateHint: Used for planning; each receipt records its own rate.
income.anchorHint: Later pay dates count from this one.
income.sourcesHint: Tap Edit on a source to change it. Ending it keeps its history.
income.amountLocked: Use 'Record a raise or change' below so earlier months keep their figures.

plan.title: Plan
plan.noBuckets: No buckets in this month's plan.
plan.noPlan: No plan yet. Save buckets to start one from this month.
plan.versionNote: This version applies from {{from}}. Saving in a later month starts a new version; earlier months keep theirs.
plan.name: Bucket name
plan.over: Over by {{percent}}%: that is {{amount}} more than this month's planned income.
plan.under: Under by {{percent}}%: {{amount}} of this month's planned income has no bucket.
plan.fixedExceeds: Fixed amounts exceed this month's planned income by {{amount}}. Later buckets get nothing until the income covers them.
plan.moveHint: The move is a transfer, not spending: it leaves one bucket and arrives in the other, and stays in this month's audit trail.

bills.title: Bills
bills.estimateHint: Planned at {{amount}}; enter what you actually paid.
bills.anchorHint: Later due dates count from this one.
bills.reminderDaysHint: Leave empty to use the default from Settings.

debts.title: Debts
debts.owingBody: Loans and money owed to others. Counted as liabilities.
debts.owedBody: Money you lent out. Counted as an asset at its outstanding balance.
debts.neverClears: Will never clear at this payment
debts.neverClearsLong: {{payment}} a month does not cover the interest. This balance will never clear.
debts.payoffLong: Clears in {{months}} months. Total {{total}}, of which {{interest}} is interest.

goals.title: Goals
goals.eitherHint: Give a date to see the monthly deposit it needs, or a deposit to see when you'll get there.
goals.required: Needs {{amount}} a month to reach it by {{date}}
goals.noProjection: Add a monthly deposit or a target date to see a projection.
goals.backingAssetHint: When set, progress follows the asset's value instead of deposits.

metals.title: Gold & silver
metals.noLots: No metal recorded yet. Add a purchase to see what it is worth today.
metals.makingHint: Counted in cost, usually lost on sale
metals.methodHint: Which purchases the sold metal is taken from; stored with the sale.
metals.chooseLots: Lots to sell from, in order
metals.notEnough: You do not hold that much.
metals.overrideBody: Your price replaces the feed until you enter a newer one. Every screen will say it is yours.
metals.rateKindHint: Official and market rates differ; the choice shows wherever converted values appear.
metals.premiumHint: What local dealers charge over spot
metals.methodLocked: Changing the default never rewrites sales already recorded.

explain.perGram: Per gram of pure gold: spot ÷ {{ounce}} g × rate = {{amount}}.
explain.overrideActive: A price you entered is currently in use instead of the feed.

networth.title: Net worth
networth.headline: What you are worth today
networth.formula: Cash + gold and silver + money owed to you + other assets − what you owe (BR-05)
networth.trendBody: One point per closed month, plus today.
networth.monthsBody: Closing a month takes a snapshot that never changes. Reopen to edit, then close again for a fresh one.
networth.needsOnline: Closing a month needs a connection.
networth.monthClosed: {{month}} is closed. Reopen it on the Net worth page to change it.
networth.householdFigure: Household total including other members' private records: {{value}}

report.title: Monthly report
report.savingRateDefinition: Saving rate = (income received − spending) ÷ income received. Transfers to goals, debts and gold are not spending.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Export everything as a JSON file you can keep or import on a new device. Import checks the file before writing anything.
data.notJson: That file is not valid JSON
data.previewBody: Rows will be written and then synced like your own edits.

account.deleteBody: Your account and household are deleted 30 days after you confirm. You can sign in and cancel until then. Export your data first if you want a copy.
account.deletionPending: This account will be deleted on {{date}} unless you cancel.

help.title: Help
help.englishOnly: This page is only available in English for now.

tours.replayed: Tours will show again on each screen.
tours.readMore: The full guide opens when you press Done.

intro.title: Welcome to Mizan
intro.body: Mizan plans one month at a time, works without a signal, and counts gold as savings. This takes half a minute.

networth.title: Net worth
networth.body: Cash plus gold and silver at today's price plus what people owe you, minus what you owe. Closing a month freezes the number.

plan.title: This month's plan
plan.body: Your income splits into buckets. Each shows what is allocated, what is committed to bills, what is spent, and what is free.

quickAdd.title: Log spending
quickAdd.body: Amount, bucket, save. It works offline and syncs when you are back online.

bills.title: Bills
bills.body: Unpaid bills are committed against their bucket from day one, so free already accounts for them.

metals.title: Gold and silver
metals.body: Record purchases by weight and purity. Mizan values them at today's price, or a price you enter yourself.

more.title: Everything else
more.body: Income, debts, goals, accounts, sync and settings live under More. The ? on each screen replays its tour or opens the guide.

figures.title: Four figures
figures.body: Allocated is this bucket's share of received income. Committed is bills, debt payments and goal deposits not yet made. Free is what remains after committed and spent.

editor.title: Change the split
editor.body: Edit names and percentages. Past months keep the plan they ran under; the change starts from the month you are viewing.

balance.title: Add up to 100%
balance.body: This line shows whether the shares add up. Rebalance scales them so they do.

save.title: Save
save.body: Saving starts a new plan version from this month when the plan began earlier.

move.title: Move money
move.body: Overspent one bucket? Move money from another with a reason. Every move is listed here and in the ledger.

month.title: Expected pay dates
month.body: Each source's pay dates for the month appear here. Mark them received when the money arrives so the plan can allocate it.

addSource.title: Add a source
addSource.body: Salary, rent, freelance: amount, currency and how often it pays.

sources.title: Raises and endings
sources.body: Edit a source to record a raise with the date it takes effect. Earlier months keep the old amount.

due.title: Due this month
due.body: Every due date with its status. Marking a bill paid records the expense and settles the obligation in one step.

add.title: Add a bill
add.body: Set the bucket, amount and frequency. Switch on amount varies for electricity and the generator.

filters.title: Find anything
filters.body: Search by payee or note; filter by bucket, type and amount.

list.title: Your entries
list.body: Grouped by day for the selected month. Tap one to edit; deleted entries wait 30 days in the recycle bin.

quickAdd.title: Add in four taps
quickAdd.body: Expense takes from a bucket. Transfer moves money to a goal, a debt or an account and is not spending.

holdings.title: What you hold
holdings.body: Total weight, cost and value at today's price, with the gain shown with and without making charges.

prices.title: Today's price
prices.body: Prices come from a feed with their source and time. Enter today's price to use the local market quote instead.

add.title: Record a purchase
add.body: Weight in grams or mithqal, purity, the price paid and the making charge kept separate.

sell.title: Selling
sell.body: Sell draws from your purchases by the method you choose and shows the realised gain.

headline.title: The number
headline.body: Assets minus liabilities with a breakdown by class. The dollar line uses the rate valuation uses.

trend.title: Over time
trend.body: One point per closed month plus today.

months.title: Closing a month
months.body: Close month takes a snapshot the app never changes. Reopen to correct something, then close again.

security.title: Lock
security.body: Choose how long the app can stay in the background before asking for the PIN.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Export everything as one file, or import one. Imports are checked before anything is written.

account.title: Account
account.body: Help, replaying tours, sync and deleting your account are here.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.body: Choose which kinds of record start as private to you. Private rows never reach other members' devices, but they still count in the household total.

notifications.title: Reminders
notifications.body: Turn on push for this device, then choose which reminders you want: bills due, pay day, overspending, month end and metal price moves.

backup.title: Cloud backup
backup.body: Set a backup passphrase and Mizan uploads an encrypted copy every day. Only the passphrase can open it, so keep it somewhere safe.

total.title: What your belongings are worth
total.body: Every held asset at its current value, converted to your base currency.

add.title: Record an asset
add.body: Pick a type and fill in what matters for it: the price, the date, and whether it should depreciate.

list.title: Grouped by type
list.body: Each card says where its value comes from: the purchase or the latest valuation, and how many months of depreciation apply.

value.title: Keep values fresh
value.body: Add a valuation whenever you know better. Home reminds you when one is older than six months.

members.title: Who is in the household
members.body: Everyone here sees the shared records. The owner sets roles: members write, viewers only look, dependents log their own spending.

invite.title: Invite by link
invite.body: Create a link and share it however you like. It works for seven days and once.

switch.title: Your households
switch.body: You keep your own household when you join another. Switch here; the app reloads with the other household's data.

assets.title: Other assets

methodHints.NONE: The value is the latest valuation you enter.
methodHints.STRAIGHT_LINE: Loses the same amount every month: the yearly rate of the baseline value, divided by twelve, down to the salvage value.
methodHints.DECLINING_BALANCE: Loses the yearly rate, divided by twelve, of what it is still worth each month, down to the salvage value.

assets.illiquid: Illiquid (cannot be turned into cash within a month)
assets.none: No assets yet. Add a car, a property or anything else worth money.
assets.sellHint: The asset leaves net worth from this date. Update your cash account with what you received.
assets.stalePrompt_one: {{name}} has not been valued for {{months}} months.
assets.stalePrompt_other: {{count}} assets have not been valued for {{months}} months.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Records marked private are only ever sent to your own devices. The household net worth still counts them, without showing them. These switches set the default for new records; each record can still be changed.

kinds.transactions: New transactions and bills are private
kinds.accounts: New cash accounts and income are private
kinds.metals: New gold and silver is private

household.title: Household
household.membersBody: Everyone who shares this household's records.
household.rolesHint: Owner: everything. Member: records and plan. Viewer: read only. Dependent: logs own spending only.
household.transferred: Ownership transferred. You are now a member.
household.needsOnline: Managing the household needs a connection.
household.inviteBody: Create a link and share it by WhatsApp or any other way. It works once and expires after seven days.
household.yoursBody: You keep your own household when you join another one. Only one is active at a time.
household.joinSignIn: Sign in or create an account first; you will come back here.
household.deleteBody: Everything in it is removed for every member seven days after you confirm. Members fall back to their own households.
household.deleteConfirm: Enter your password to confirm. You can cancel within seven days.
household.deletionPending: This household will be deleted seven days after {{date}}.

notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications. On iPhone, install Mizan to the home screen first.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for Mizan in this browser's settings.
notifications.iosHint: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work once Mizan is installed to the home screen.
notifications.leadDays: Days before a bill is due

exports.body: Spreadsheets for your own analysis; column names follow the app language.

backup.title: Cloud backup
backup.body: Once a day, an encrypted copy of everything goes to the server. It can only be opened with your backup passphrase, which is not your PIN and is never sent anywhere.
backup.passphraseHint: At least 8 characters. Write it down: a lost passphrase means the backups cannot be opened, not even by us.
backup.passphraseSet: Backups are on. The first one uploads with the next sync.
backup.queued: Backup queued; it uploads with the next sync
backup.restoreHint: Enter the passphrase this backup was made with. You will see what it contains before anything is written.
backup.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase does not open this backup.
